thread:
incident-bot: Pager: KV cache continuous-batch error rate > 5% across mistral-*. Prefetch amplification detected. Priority: P1.
ryan-oncall: Seeing big tail latency on mistral-7b / qwen-8k. Telemetry shows KV write amplification at 3x usual; cont-batching queues spiking.
sam-support: Customer @big-retail reports timeouts for embed ingestion at 08:12 UTC. They saw 504s and started failing retry loops.
hao-ml: Investigating model-specific prefix cardinality. Mistral traces show many short prefixes causing cache churn + repeated miss storms. GQA traffic looks fine; MQA heavy.
eli-infra: Node-level: a subset of GPU hosts hit sustained GC on shardstore, OOM not seen but disk spool thrashing. Throttles at frontend mounting.
ryan-oncall: Quick mitigation: throttle cont-batching for mistral model family to 4 concurrent batches, fallback to smaller batch sizes for MQA-heavy routes. Implementing now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: kerberos/kv-config@hotfix-20260315 -> rolling to prod (15% -> 50% -> 100%).
anya-pm: Heads-up: active customers on dedicated capacity may see increased per-token cost during mitigation. Coordinate comms?
hao-ml: Root cause hypothesis: a recent batching heuristic change favors longer aggregation windows; combined with prefix diversity in mistral GQA->MQA workloads, KV prefetch hit ratio dropped from 82% to 46%. Continuous batching kept growing queues.
eli-infra: Temporary rule applied: route mistral-7b and mistral-11b traffic to contbatch_limit=2 and kv_prefetch=false for routes tagged "interactive". Applied via config push to region-eu and region-us.
ryan-oncall: Confirming reduction in write amplification. Error rate down to 1.8% after 6 minutes. Latency 95p improved from 1.9s -> 760ms.
sam-support: Customer @big-retail confirmed retries stopped, ingestion resumed. They asked for postmortem and ETA to revert.
hao-ml: Plan: revert batching window heuristic and add model-family aware prefix grouping. Short term hotfix: pin contiguous KV keys for mistral families and enable per-model cache caps. Will open PR with perf numbers.
anya-pm: Please include expected rollback plan and impact on Dedicated customers. Also track cost delta from smaller batches.
ryan-oncall: Oncall notes: paged at 08:10 UTC, mitigation rolled 08:18 UTC, full config rollout 08:27 UTC. No customer data loss, only increased latency for 15m.
deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout reached 100% at 08:27 UTC.
eli-infra: Followup: scheduled a rolling restart of kv-shard-12 (suspected shard hotspot) during low traffic window 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
hao-ml: Action items: 1) revert batching window change in dev by EOD, 2) add per-model cache cap + telemetry for prefetch miss ratio, 3) create regression test with high prefix cardinality traffic.
sam-support: I'll draft a short customer note for impacted customers summarizing cause, mitigation, and next steps.
ryan-oncall: Thanks team. I'll hand over to morning oncall for postmortem. Marking incident resolved->monitoring for 12h. :white_check_mark:
customer-ops: Thanks, confirmed service stable on our side. We'll follow up if anything else crops up.
incident-bot: Incident closed (P1 -> resolved). Duration: 17m. Linked ticket: INC-20260315-789.
